title: Mileage Allowance Earned at Turn-In by Closed-End Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Units
content:
# Contract Terms — Mileage Allowance Earned by a Closed-End Unit at Turn-In, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Term.** For the excess mileage charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose lease ended by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the mileage allowance earned is figured by the days in service for a unit turned in before its scheduled end date after at least the minimum term (12 whole months, the minimum term in every program tier) in service, as the annual mileage allowance multiplied by the days from the in-service date to the turn-in date and divided by 365; for a unit turned in on or after its scheduled end date it is the annual mileage allowance multiplied by the term in months and divided by 12; every other unit earns the annual mileage allowance multiplied by its months in service and divided by 12.

**Counting.** The turn-in date is the one the unit records for its turn-in or recovery. Days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later one and are one fewer where the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's; the whole months in service for the minimum-term test run from the in-service date to the turn-in date.

## Branch table

| Turn-in date against scheduled end date | Whole months, in-service date to turn-in date | Allowance earned |
|---|---|---|
| before the scheduled end date | 12 or more | annual allowance multiplied by the days from in-service date to turn-in date, divided by 365 |
| on or after the scheduled end date | any | annual allowance multiplied by the term in months, divided by 12 |
| before the scheduled end date | fewer than 12 | annual allowance multiplied by the months in service, divided by 12 |

## Cases (hypothetical, annual allowance 24000, term 36 months)

1. Turned in before its scheduled end date, 14 whole months and 438 days after its in-service date: 24000 multiplied by 438, divided by 365, is 28800 miles.
2. Turned in on its scheduled end date: 24000 multiplied by 36, divided by 12, is 72000 miles. Turned in one day after it: the same 72000.
3. Turned in before its scheduled end date, 11 whole months after its in-service date, with 11 months in service on the schedule: 24000 multiplied by 11, divided by 12, is 22000 miles.
4. Boundary of the minimum term: in service on the 5th of a month and turned in on the 4th of the month twelve months later is 11 whole months (third row); turned in on the 5th of that month, it is 12 whole months (first row).
